splash_content.title: DISCOVER THE BEST FEATURES OF THIS VERSION

articles.title: Full security rework
articles.desc: The code base has been completely reworked to improve security throughout the whole extension.

articles.title: GDPR pixel tracking
articles.desc: We added a new option to handle the pixel tracking according to the new GDPR regulation.

splash_content.title: THE FIXES INCLUDED IN THIS VERSION

articles.title: 404 after data deletion
articles.desc: We fixed a redirection to a 404 page that occurred after a user deleted their data from the profile page.

articles.title: Tracked link redirection
articles.desc: We fixed an issue where clicking a tracked link in an email could redirect to the unsubscribe URL when a subscriber custom field containing HTML was inserted in the email body.

articles.title: Events Manager timezone
articles.desc: [add-on] The event dates for Events Manager now use the correct timezone.

articles.title: Transactional emails blocked
articles.desc: We fixed an issue that caused transactional WordPress emails to be silently blocked and not sent when AcyMailing had already handled another email during the same request.

articles.title: Events in emails timezone
articles.desc: [add-ons] A better timezone management is made for Events Manager events inserted in emails.

articles.title: Multiple Contact Form 7 forms
articles.desc: [add-ons] A conflict has been fixed when multiple Contact Form 7 forms are shown on the same page and use the same field identifiers.
